dialogue.speaker: Mira
dialogue.text: I went to Đà Lạt last week. I didn't expect Vietnam to have such a cool place. Đà Lạt is completely different from Saigon, beautiful scenery and peaceful.

dialogue.speaker: Michael
dialogue.text: Đà Lạt is truly a paradise for du lịch. I plan to go to Đà Lạt next month. Is there anything interesting there that you'd like to recommend?

dialogue.speaker: Mira
dialogue.text: Xuan Huong Lake is very beautiful, but too crowded with tourists. I thích the small roads through pine forests more. If you thích quiet places, we could... oh no, I mean you should visit places that fewer people know about.

dialogue.speaker: Michael
dialogue.text: "We could" sounds good to me. Why not du lịch to Đà Lạt together? I want to explore those pine forest roads with someone who knows the place well.

dialogue.speaker: Mira
dialogue.text: Don't misunderstand! I'm not good at guiding. But... if you really want to du lịch, I might consider it. Only because I also want to go to Đà Lạt again, not for any other reason!
